descricao_original: The maturation of germ cells occurs in cell-association stages, each with a unique group of developing cells undergoing spermatogenesis.

marcadores.explicacao_original: In humans, developing stages form irregularly-shaped patches that do not extend completely around the lumen. Thus, any given cross section will contain more than one stage. There are 6 stages in humans and they are not arranged sequentially along the tubule.
marcadores.legenda_ia: Camada transparente de anotacao da pagina 'Stages of spermatogenesis'. Deve ser sobreposta, sem redimensionamento independente, a 'O.R.M.T.TP-7.jpg'. Destaca a estrutura ou conceito 'Human' por setas, contornos ou marcadores coloridos (incluindo vermelho quando presente). There are 6 stages in humans and they are not arranged sequentially along the tubule.. marcadores.explicacao_original: In rodents and non-human primates, the stages extend around the entire circumference of the tubule. Thus, individual cross sections contain a single cell-association stage and they are arranged sequentially along the tubule.
